purpose: Supplementary provenance record for the historical reference assets used by the DSE Norway-spruce RNA-seq reanalysis. This record only consolidates existing receipts and read-only build records; it does not rerun a download, build, or checksum calculation.

original_asset.official_md5_status: No official MD5 value for this TreeGenes-hosted CDS file was located in the preserved receipts/build records. The SHA-256 above is the historical local download receipt, not an asserted publisher checksum.

derived_quantification_asset.construction: Exclude any original CDS containing N, then collapse exact CDS sequences into sequence-equivalence units; counts were not expanded back to individual genes.
derived_quantification_asset.checksum_scope: Derived uncompressed quantification FASTA, not the original compressed TreeGenes download. The value was taken from quantification_ready.json/reference artifact manifest; it was not recomputed in this supplementary-record step.

near_species_fungal_proxy.role: Competition/host-attribution sensitivity only; it is not an exact P. sphaeroides reference, fungal quantification, or independent validation.
near_species_fungal_proxy.historical_name_evidence_in_saved_report: The saved NCBI report gives the BioProject/sample title as 'Phialocephala scopiformis CBS 120377'. Project reference_config.json labels the assembly 'Mollisia scopiformis formerly Phialocephala scopiformis'. This record does not independently verify nomenclatural synonymy beyond those preserved records.

source_asset.official_md5_verification_in_build_recor: The reference-preparation script records a successful local MD5 comparison against the downloaded NCBI md5checksums.txt before constructing the competition FASTA. This supplementary-record step did not redo the checksum.

derived_competition_asset.checksum_scope: Derived combined FASTA; not the original NCBI compressed CDS asset.

unresolved_or_explicitly_not_claimed: No publisher-provided MD5 for Paab.1_0b.cds.fa.gz was recovered from the preserved metadata; do not convert its receipt SHA-256 into an official checksum claim.
The primary derived FASTA hash and competition derived FASTA hash identify the built artifacts, not the original upstream compressed source files.

No exact P. sphaeroides assembly/CDS reference was present in frozen reference evidence. A separate historical NCBI query receipt for the species returned a 2-byte response and is not a usable reference asset.

The current NCBI organism label at GCA_001500285.1 is Mollisia scopiformis. Any use of the historical P. scopiformis name should retain the accession and label it as a historical/project-record designation unless an independent taxonomic authority is supplied.
read_only_audit_note: Remote inspection was restricted to existing continuation, metadata, reference-build and receipt records. No computation, installation, indexing, download, or task launch was performed.
